header.title: Privacy Policy
header.subtitle: How TenthMatrix collects, uses, and protects your personal data

introduction.title: Introduction & Scope
introduction.content: TenthMatrix Ltd ('we', 'us', 'our') is committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our website, applications, and services (collectively, 'Services'). This policy complies with the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR), Data Protection Act 2018, and other applicable data protection laws. By using our Services, you consent to the practices described in this policy.

sections.title: Data Controller & Contact Information
sections.content: TenthMatrix Ltd is the data controller responsible for your personal data:
items: Company Name: TenthMatrix Ltd
Registration Number: 12345678 (England & Wales)
Registered Address: 123 Tech Street, London, EC2A 4NE, United Kingdom
ICO Registration: ZA123456
Data Protection Officer: dpo@tenthmatrix.com
Privacy Inquiries: privacy@tenthmatrix.com
Phone: +44 20 7123 4567

subsections.subtitle: Information You Provide Directly
items: Account Information: Name, email address, phone number, company name, job title, password
Profile Information: Profile photo, bio, preferences, timezone, language
Payment Information: Billing address, payment method details (processed by Stripe—we don't store card numbers)
Communication Data: Messages, support tickets, emails, chat conversations with AI agents
User Content: Documents, code, data, prompts, and files you upload or create
Feedback & Surveys: Responses to surveys, product feedback, feature requests

subsections.subtitle: Information Collected Automatically
items: Usage Data: Pages visited, features used, time spent, click patterns, session duration
Device Information: IP address, browser type and version, operating system, device type, screen resolution
Cookies & Tracking: See our Cookie Policy for details on cookies and similar technologies
Log Data: Access logs, error logs, API requests, timestamps
Performance Data: Page load times, API response times, error rates
Location Data: Approximate location based on IP address (city/country level)

subsections.subtitle: Information from Third Parties
items: Social Login: Profile information from Google, LinkedIn, Microsoft if you use SSO
Business Information: Company data from public sources (Companies House, LinkedIn)
Payment Providers: Transaction status and verification from Stripe
Analytics Partners: Aggregated usage insights from Google Analytics, Hotjar
Referral Partners: Information from affiliates or marketing partners

subsections.subtitle: AI-Specific Data Collection
items: Prompts & Inputs: Questions and commands you provide to AI agents
AI Outputs: Responses and content generated by AI agents
Conversation History: Your interaction history with AI agents for context
Model Usage: Which AI models you use (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, etc.)
Training Opt-In: If you consent, your interactions may improve AI models (anonymized)

sections.title: Legal Basis for Processing
sections.content: Under UK GDPR, we process your personal data based on the following legal grounds:
items: Contract Performance: Processing necessary to provide Services you've signed up for (Article 6(1)(b))
Consent: Where you've given explicit consent (e.g., marketing emails, AI training opt-in) (Article 6(1)(a))
Legitimate Interests: For fraud prevention, security, analytics, and product improvement (Article 6(1)(f))
Legal Obligations: To comply with tax, accounting, and legal requirements (Article 6(1)(c))
Vital Interests: To protect life or safety in emergency situations (Article 6(1)(d))
Public Interest: For research and statistical purposes with appropriate safeguards (Article 6(1)(e))

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We use your personal data for the following purposes:

subsections.subtitle: Service Provision
items: Create and manage your account
Provide access to AI agents, CRM, DevOps tools, and other features
Process payments and manage subscriptions
Provide customer support and respond to inquiries
Send service-related notifications (downtime, updates, security alerts)
Maintain conversation context for AI agents

subsections.subtitle: Service Improvement & Development
items: Analyze usage patterns to improve product features
Conduct A/B testing and product experiments
Debug issues and fix technical problems
Improve AI model accuracy and performance (with consent)
Develop new features and services
Personalize your experience and recommendations

subsections.subtitle: Security & Fraud Prevention
items: Detect and prevent fraud, abuse, and security threats
Monitor for unauthorized access and suspicious activities
Verify identity and prevent account takeovers
Enforce our Terms of Service and Acceptable Use Policy
Respond to security incidents and data breaches

subsections.subtitle: Marketing & Communications
items: Send promotional emails about new features (with consent)
Display relevant advertisements on third-party platforms
Conduct market research and surveys
Measure effectiveness of marketing campaigns
You can opt-out of marketing emails anytime

subsections.subtitle: Legal & Compliance
items: Comply with legal obligations and court orders
Enforce our legal rights and defend against claims
Maintain business records and audit trails
Conduct internal audits and compliance reviews
Respond to law enforcement requests (with legal process)

sections.title: How We Share Your Information
sections.content: We do not sell your personal data. We share your information only in the following circumstances:

subsections.subtitle: Service Providers (Data Processors)
subsections.content: We share data with trusted third parties who process data on our behalf:
items: Cloud Hosting: AWS (UK/EU regions) for infrastructure
AI Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google for AI processing (you control which models to use)
Payment Processing: Stripe for payment transactions
Analytics: Google Analytics, Hotjar, Mixpanel for usage insights
Customer Support: Intercom, Zendesk for support ticketing
Email Services: SendGrid, Mailchimp for transactional and marketing emails
Monitoring: Sentry, Datadog for error tracking and performance
Authentication: Auth0 for SSO and identity management
subsections.details: All processors are bound by Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) and must comply with UK GDPR.

subsections.subtitle: Business Transfers
subsections.content: If we undergo a merger, acquisition, sale, or insolvency, your data may be transferred to the successor entity. We will notify you and ensure the new entity honors this Privacy Policy.

subsections.subtitle: Legal Requirements
subsections.content: We may disclose data if required by law or in good faith belief that disclosure is necessary to:
items: Comply with legal process (subpoenas, court orders)
Enforce our Terms of Service
Protect our rights, property, or safety
Protect the rights, property, or safety of others
Prevent fraud or criminal activity

subsections.subtitle: With Your Consent
subsections.content: We may share data with third parties if you give explicit consent (e.g., sharing data with integrations you connect).

subsections.subtitle: Aggregated & Anonymized Data
subsections.content: We may share aggregated, anonymized data that cannot identify you (e.g., industry benchmarks, usage statistics) for research, marketing, or partnerships.

sections.title: International Data Transfers
sections.content: Your data is primarily stored in the UK (AWS London region). However, some service providers are based outside the UK/EEA:
items: OpenAI (USA): For GPT models—data processed in US data centers (Standard Contractual Clauses in place)
Anthropic (USA): For Claude models—data processed in US (Standard Contractual Clauses)
Google (USA/Global): For Gemini, Analytics, and Workspace (UK GDPR compliant with DPA)
Stripe (USA/EU): Payment processing with UK/EU data localization options
safeguards: We use Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the UK ICO
We conduct Transfer Impact Assessments (TIAs) for high-risk transfers
You can request UK-only data residency (Enterprise plan)
We do not transfer data to countries with inadequate data protection (e.g., China, Russia)

sections.title: Data Retention
sections.content: We retain your personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes outlined in this policy:
items: Active Accounts: Data retained while your account is active
After Account Closure: Data deleted within 30 days (except as required by law)
Backups: Backup copies deleted within 90 days after account closure
Legal Hold: Data retained longer if required for legal claims or compliance
Anonymized Data: May be retained indefinitely for analytics
Marketing Data: Retained until you unsubscribe or request deletion
AI Training Data: If you opt-in, anonymized data may be retained to improve models
details: AI Conversation History: 90 days (or until you delete)

sections.title: Your Privacy Rights (UK GDPR)
sections.content: Under UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018, you have the following rights:

rights.description: Request a copy of your personal data we hold. We provide this free of charge within 30 days.
Correct inaccurate or incomplete personal data. You can update most data in account settings.

rights.right: Right to Erasure / 'Right to be Forgotten' (Article 17)
rights.description: Request deletion of your data. We will delete unless we have a legal reason to retain it.
Request that we limit processing of your data in certain circumstances (e.g., while disputing accuracy).
Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format (JSON, CSV) to transfer to another provider.
Object to processing based on legitimate interests (e.g., marketing, profiling). We will stop unless we have compelling reasons.
Withdraw consent for processing at any time (e.g., unsubscribe from marketing, opt-out of AI training).
Complain to the UK Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) at https://ico.org.uk/make-a-complaint/

sections.howToExercise: To exercise your rights, email dpo@tenthmatrix.com or use the Data Subject Request form in your account settings. We will respond within 30 days.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
sections.content: Our Services are not intended for children under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If we discover we have collected data from a child, we will delete it immediately. If you believe we have data from a child, please contact us at privacy@tenthmatrix.com.

subsections.subtitle: AI Model Training
items: Opt-In Only: We never use your data to train public AI models without explicit consent.
Anonymization: If you opt-in, data is anonymized before use in training.
Private Models: Enterprise customers can train private models on their data only.
No Personal Data: We do not include personal data (names, emails, etc.) in public model training.
Right to Deletion: If you request data deletion, we remove your data from future training datasets.

subsections.subtitle: AI Conversation Privacy
items: Context Retention: We store conversation history to maintain context across sessions (90 days).
No Human Review: We do not review your AI conversations unless you report an issue or opt-in for quality improvement.
Third-Party AI Providers: When using OpenAI/Anthropic models, their privacy policies also apply (we use their zero-retention APIs where available).
End-to-End Encryption: Available for sensitive conversations (Enterprise plan).

subsections.subtitle: Automated Decision-Making & Profiling
items: We use AI for limited automated decisions (e.g., spam detection, fraud prevention).
You have the right to object to automated decisions that significantly affect you.
You can request human review of any automated decision.
We do not use AI for decisions about employment, credit, or legal matters without human oversight.

sections.title: Data Security Measures
sections.content: We implement comprehensive security measures to protect your data. See our Security Policy for full details. Key measures include:
items: Encryption: AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit
Access Controls: Role-based access, multi-factor authentication, principle of least privilege
Network Security: Firewalls, DDoS protection, intrusion detection
Monitoring: 24/7 security operations center, real-time threat detection
Incident Response: Comprehensive plan with notification procedures
Regular Audits: Third-party penetration testing, ISO 27001 certification
Employee Training: All staff receive security awareness training
Data Breach Notification: We will notify you within 72 hours of discovering a breach affecting your data

sections.title: Cookies & Tracking Technologies
sections.content: We use cookies and similar technologies to provide and improve our Services. For detailed information, please see our Cookie Policy. Key points:
items: Essential Cookies: Required for authentication, security, and core functionality
Analytics Cookies: Google Analytics, Hotjar for usage insights (you can opt-out)
Marketing Cookies: For advertising and retargeting (requires consent in UK/EU)
Cookie Management: You can control cookies via our consent manager or browser settings
Do Not Track: We honor Global Privacy Control (GPC) signals

subsections.subtitle: Email Marketing
items: We send promotional emails about new features, updates, and offers (with consent).
You can unsubscribe anytime using the link in every email.
We do not sell email lists to third parties.
Transactional emails (receipts, security alerts) cannot be unsubscribed.

subsections.subtitle: Advertising
items: We use Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and Facebook Ads for retargeting.
You can opt-out via ad settings on those platforms.
We do not share personal data with advertisers (only hashed identifiers).

sections.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in our practices, legal requirements, or new features. When we make material changes:
items: We will update the 'Last Updated' date at the top
We will display a prominent notice on our website for 30 days
We will send an email notification to registered users
For significant changes, we may request renewed consent
sections.recommendation: We encourage you to review this policy periodically to stay informed about how we protect your data.

sections.title: Additional Rights for California Residents (CCPA)
sections.content: If you are a California resident, you have additional rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA):
items: Right to Know: Request details about personal data collected, used, and shared
Right to Delete: Request deletion of personal data (with exceptions)
Right to Opt-Out: Opt-out of 'sale' of personal data (we do not sell data)
Right to Non-Discrimination: We will not discriminate against you for exercising your rights
Authorized Agent: You can designate an authorized agent to make requests on your behalf
sections.contact: California residents can exercise these rights by emailing privacy@tenthmatrix.com or calling +44 20 7123 4567.
